final: SELECT d.A3 AS region_name, AVG(g.n) AS average_count, AVG(g.n / CAST(t.total AS REAL)) AS average_fraction FROM (SELECT c.district_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3) AS g JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = g.district_id AND d.A3 = g.region_name CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3)) AS t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.A3
